selection.algorithm: minimum seeded SHA-256 rank over sealed TRAIN lookup asset_id
selection.population: 28 sealed TRAIN lookup assets in review/phase1/approved/registry.jsonl
selection.reserve_policy: Reserve is promoted only for a mechanical serialization or span defect that does not test the hypothesis. It is never promoted to replace a pair whose teacher outcome is disliked.

local_invariants: positive text contains the exact sealed subject as a proper span inside a clearly unresolved natural-language need
positive text contains no explicit lookup or refresh command framing
negative text contains the same subject but only mentions or reports it
positive expected action is an exact-span delegate
every subject occurs exactly once in its own text, so the span is unambiguous
